title: The Second Cable
disclaimer: All characters, incidents, reported cables, and player choices in this mission are fictional. The historical source is contextual only.
scenario: A fictional intelligence station receives contradictory reports about a rumoured meeting. The player determines the confidence of the available evidence before making a recommendation.

claims.statement: An unverified informant reports a closed meeting.
Municipal records suggest the same meeting was public.
A local editor requests a correction to an earlier unverified statement.

notes: No distribution mechanics, messaging scripts or modern audience targeting. Future events use finite budgets and deterministic actions.
